summary: Contango Silver & Gold Inc. filed a routine Form 8-K disclosing a new corporate presentation (Exhibit 99.2) under Item 7.01 and the completion of a Technical Report Summary effective September 11, 2026, for the Kitsault Valley Project under Regulation S-K subpart 1300, filed as Exhibit 96.1 with a related press release (Exhibit 99.1). The registrant holds a 30% interest in Peak Gold, LLC, managed by Kinross Gold, which supplied certain non-GAAP measures under IFRS. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural/regulatory terms are stated; no special-situation event is present.
